description: This Java source file defines the CreateBsonPredicateVisitor class, which implements the PredicateVisitor interface to convert Predicate objects into MongoDB Bson filters. It supports various predicate types including equality, range, in, and pattern matching, optimizing regex queries by removing unnecessary wildcards.

classes.name: CreateBsonPredicateVisitor
classes.description: A singleton class that implements PredicateVisitor to generate MongoDB BSON filters from predicates for use in queries.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of CreateBsonPredicateVisitor, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Creates a BSON filter from a given predicate and field name.

methods.name: visitEq
methods.description: Generates a BSON equality filter for the specified value.

methods.name: visitGe
methods.description: Generates a BSON 'greater than or equal' filter.

methods.name: visitIn
methods.description: Generates a BSON 'in' filter for a list of values.

methods.name: visitLe
methods.description: Generates a BSON 'less than or equal' filter.

methods.name: visitLike
methods.description: Generates a BSON regex filter based on a pattern string, optimizing regex performance by removing leading and trailing wildcards.

methods.name: removeLeadingOrTrailingWildcard
methods.description: Removes leading (^\Q\E) and trailing (.*\Q\E$) wildcards from a pattern string to improve query performance.
